messages:
Mia Chen: Heads up — when I open the new compact modal from the breadcrumb in the console, the modal header visually bumps into the breadcrumb at narrow widths. Seen on staging.
Sam Patel: I can repro locally. Feels like a spacing token mismatch between breadcrumb and modal header. Screenshot?
Mia Chen: uploaded screenshot to the thread (staging). you can see the header overlaps the breadcrumb separator.
Lucía Rivera: likely caused by the change we did to reduce modal vertical padding for dense screens. Breadcrumbs still use the larger container gap. I think we ended up with `spacing.compact-1` vs `spacing.compact-3`.
Arjun Iyer: quick snippet from the component: ```css
.modal--compact { padding: var(--spacing-compact-1); }
.breadcrumb { gap: var(--spacing-compact-3); }
```
Arjun Iyer: Proposal: standardize the vertical gap between breadcrumb and modal header to `spacing.compact-2` so it sits in the middle and is predictable.
Mia Chen: agreed. Also noticed toasts overlap the breadcrumb area on some pages when 2+ toasts stack at the bottom-left. They don't respect the page shell bottom height.
Sam Patel: toast container is anchored to viewport bottom and uses safe-area insets, but ignores the shell/footer height var. We should either move to inside main content or add `bottom: calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + var(--shell-bottom))`.
design-bot: automated check — token "spacing.compact-2" not present in tokens.json. Suggest creating token and referencing it in both breadcrumb and modal. (lint-id: token-missing-19384)
Lucía Rivera: OK plan: 1) add `spacing.compact-2` token and swap both breadcrumb gap and modal top padding to it; 2) update toast stacking to account for `--shell-bottom`. That should fix overlap across pages.
Oliver Park: I'll own the toast change. I'll add the bottom calc and run visual diffs. Assigning to @Oliver Park.
Mia Chen: Sam, can you pick up the modal token switch? Just replace the padding var and add a short comment explaining the cross-component token.
Sam Patel: on it. Draft PR will include this snippet: ```css
.modal--compact { padding-top: var(--spacing-compact-2); }
/* keep left/right padding unchanged to preserve hit targets */
```
Arjun Iyer: accessibility nit: screen readers sometimes read "dialog" twice when breadcrumb is present. Suspect aria-labelledby links to breadcrumb accidentally. Ensure modal `aria-labelledby` points only to the modal title element, not to breadcrumb elements.
Mia Chen: good catch — add that to the PR checklist.
Oliver Park: PR for toast container ready, running screenshots now. Will ping when CI is green :thumbsup: 
Sam Patel: PR opened for modal token + aria fix (staging link in PR).
Mia Chen: merged both PRs after review and spot-checked staging. Spacing looks consistent on narrow/wide, toasts no longer overlap breadcrumb. Closing this thread.
